name: standing thoracic extension with elbows back
description: A standing upper-back extension drill with the hands behind the head and elbows opening to the sides.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and place your hands lightly behind your head.
Start with your elbows slightly forward, then open them out and back while lifting through the upper chest.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back.
Return the elbows forward under control and repeat.
